info.title: Logistics Management REST API
info.description:
RESTful HTTP API for logistics analysts to register and manage core fleet and transit resources:
- **Vehicles**: Fleet vehicles, payload capacities, and operational statuses.
- **Drivers**: Driver personnel records, commercial license classifications, and availability statuses.
- **Routes**: Transit and delivery routes composed of an ordered sequence of geographic waypoints.

### REST Design Principles
This API follows:
- **Core REST Principles**: Resource-oriented plural nouns, standard HTTP method semantics (`GET`, `POST`, `PUT`, `PATCH`, `DELETE`), statelessness, and hypermedia/location headers.
- **Microsoft Azure REST API Guidelines**: Explicit URI path versioning (`/v1`), optimistic concurrency control via `ETag` and `If-Match` headers, `Idempotency-Key` support for safe retries on `POST`, and standardized `application/problem+json` error payloads.
- **Google Cloud API Design Guide (AIPs)**: Token-based pagination (`pageSize`, `pageToken`, `nextPageToken`, `totalCount`), standard collection filtering (`status`, `search`), and consistent resource lifecycle timestamps (`createdAt`, `updatedAt`).

post.description: Creates a new vehicle record in the fleet registry. Returns `201 Created` with a `Location` header pointing to the new resource URI and an `ETag` header for optimistic concurrency control.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Optional client-generated unique key (e.g., UUID) to guarantee idempotent resource creation across network retries.

Location.description: Canonical URI of the newly created resource.

ETag.description: Opaque entity tag representing the current version of the resource for optimistic concurrency control.

409.description: A conflict occurred with the current state of the target resource (`409 Conflict`), such as a duplicate unique identifier (VIN, license plate, employee number, or route code).

500.description: An unexpected server error occurred (`500 Internal Server Error`).

get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of vehicles, with optional filtering by operational status, vehicle type, minimum payload capacity, or free-text search.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return per page (default 25, max 100).

parameters.name: pageToken
parameters.description: Opaque continuation token returned from a previous list call (`nextPageToken`) to fetch the next page of results.

parameters.name: orderBy
parameters.description: Sort expression (e.g., `createdAt desc`, `name asc`).

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by operational status.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Filter by vehicle type classification.

parameters.name: minCapacityKg
parameters.description: Filter vehicles with payload capacity greater than or equal to this value in kilograms.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive free-text filter applied across key identifying fields.

500.description: An unexpected server error occurred (`500 Internal Server Error`).

put.description: Performs a full replacement of an existing vehicle record. Clients may supply an `If-Match` header with the resource's current `ETag` to prevent lost updates.

parameters.name: vehicleId
parameters.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the vehicle.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: Optional entity tag (`ETag`) value for optimistic concurrency control. If the resource has been modified since this `ETag` was issued, the server returns `412 Precondition Failed`.
